args.message: Upgrade fastjson 2.8.0 -> 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337 (unbounded recursion in deeply nested array parsing)

args.body:
## Summary
Upgrades fastjson from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 to remediate CVE-2026-31337 (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. Affected versions are <2.9.4; 2.9.4 is the fixed release on the 2.x line.

## Changes
- `requirements.txt`: `fastjson==2.8.0` → `fastjson==2.9.4`

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on `c8b8ab7878`: **passed**

Closes CVE-2026-31337 exposure.
